sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Local studio EBBA Architects has designed the first London outpost for Istanbul cafe chain Cup of Joy, using clay plaster, stone and an opaque-glass ceiling to evoke the feeling of being in a courtyard. The studio drew on the coffee chain's founding location as inspiration for the two-storey cafe, set in central London's upmarket Marylebone The post EBBA Architects designs Cup of Joy cafe in Marylebone to "provide a sense of delight" appeared first on Dezeen .
